Aanand attempted to negotiate by offering three months' rent in advance, but the landlord remained firm in his decision. The incident highlights the struggles of entrepreneurs in finding housing due to financial perceptions.

title: B'luru man's AC stops working after Voltas reinstallation, company ordered to pay Rs 33k

The company’s technicians allegedly mishandled the installation of the unit during relocation from Chennai to Bengaluru. The commission awarded the customer a total of Rs 33,770, addressing the operational loss, installation charges, harassment, and litigation expenses. Documents submitted showed the air conditioner was functional before being reinstalled and later became non-functional.

However, the film's music, despite its collaboration with A.R. Rahman and Hans Zimmer, was not submitted for awards consideration.

title: Congress to hold nationwide ‘Samvidhan Raksha’ marches tomorrow

Each Pradesh Congress Committee will begin the marches at notable statues of BR Ambedkar or Mahatma Gandhi. Additionally, party workers will verify voter lists and assist with electoral rights reclamation. Concerns have been raised about alleged irregularities in electoral rolls and the electoral process.

title: BSE Sensex jumps over 2,000 points; Nifty50 crosses 25,900 - what's fueling the rally
description: The Indian stock market showcased remarkable momentum on Wednesday, as the BSE Sensex jumped more than 2,000 points. This rally can be attributed mainly to hefty foreign investments, alongside easing crude oil prices that lifted inflation fears. Major private banks drove the surge, highlighting the strength of the domestic corporate sector. In a time of global uncertainty, Indian equities proved their durability, buoyed by ongoing investor optimism.

description: The catch came in the sixth over of GKR Dir's innings when a batter struck the ball over the extra-cover boundary.

title: DU student found dead in Faridabad hotel after checking in with neighbour
description: A 19-year-old Delhi University student was found dead in a hotel room in Faridabad on Tuesday morning. Police suspect her neighbor, who checked into the room with her, and have registered a murder case. The student had informed her family she was going to college but turned unreachable around 3pm. A handwritten note and rat poison were discovered at the crime scene, raising further suspicions.

title: How Yuvraj Singh's 30-minute call unleashed Sooryavanshi's record-breaking 204
description: Vaibhav Sooryavanshi delivered an unforgettable performance, smashing 204 runs from 53 balls in the match against UAE. Prior to this, he had been struggling with his game, but a crucial discussion with Yuvraj Singh revived his spirits and helped him address his technical issues. His innings were highlighted by 28 sixes, ultimately leading India to a decisive seven-wicket victory, demonstrating his exceptional skill and determination.

title: ‘Are we beggars?’ Congress fumes as Akhilesh offers 26 seats for UP polls
description: Tensions have surfaced between the Samajwadi Party and Congress ahead of the 2027 Uttar Pradesh Assembly elections, with Congress MP Imran Masood asking, "Are we beggars?" over SP's offer of 26 seats. While Congress is seeking 120 seats, Akhilesh Yadav has stressed winnability and called for further discussions to defeat the BJP.

title: ‘Not a single bogus vote to be added’: Akhilesh asks SP workers to monitor ECI
description: Akhilesh Yadav has called on Samajwadi Party workers to monitor electoral roll activities ahead of the upcoming elections. He emphasized that no bogus votes should be added and no genuine votes should be removed from the lists. Yadav expressed concerns regarding the credibility of Electronic Voting Machines, reflecting public scepticism and recent controversies. He also urged Congress to identify additional winnable constituencies for the seat-sharing negotiations.

title: 'Lot of runs here': Forget pacer-friendly reputation, Hagley pitch can flatten out
description: "I think every game's different, every surface you play on is slightly different as well. And I think there's been a lot of runs scored here of late as well," Henry said at a press conference on Wednesday.

title: UP woman escapes hotel room after assault, ex-boyfriend drags her back
description: A 24-year-old woman escaped a hotel in Meerut where her ex-boyfriend confined and assaulted her. She reported that he chased her after she fled the hotel room on Tuesday. The incident was captured on CCTV and prompted police intervention following alerts from passersby. The suspect, identified as Mohd Salman, fled across rooftops when police arrived at the scene quickly.

title: Royal Enfield owner gets Rs 1 lakh copensation as bike's ECU issue disrupts Leh trip
description: In a recent ruling, a Delhi consumer commission mandated Eicher Motors to compensate a Noida resident whose Interceptor 650 suffered severe power loss at higher altitudes. Despite the complainant's prior request for an ECU update before his journey, the authorized dealer neglected to take action, leaving the commission with no choice but to side with the complainant, awarding him Rs 1 lakh in compensation for the unaddressed claims.

title: Watch: Armed men hold 30 hostage in Colombia supermarket; 10 rescued
description: In Cartagena, Colombia, a distressing situation unfolded as armed assailants took at least 20 hostages in a supermarket following a botched armored cash van heist. The police swiftly secured the vicinity, facilitating the release of some hostages. Authorities reassured citizens of their commitment to ensure the safe return of all captives. Meanwhile, flight operations at Rafael Núñez Airport resumed soon after the crisis began.

title: 300 BJP, Hindu outfit members booked over Thiruparankundram Deepam protests
description: Around 300 BJP and Hindu organisation members have been booked for protesting in Tamil Nadu's Thiruparankundram over the non-lighting of the Karthigai Deepam at the Deepathoon pillar, despite a Supreme Court interim order. The lamp was instead lit at the Uchi Pillayar temple. BJP leaders accused the state government of defying the court, while protests also erupted elsewhere in Tamil Nadu.

title: 'Will take Bangladesh by Dec 16': Bengal minister vows revenge for killings of Hindus
description: West Bengal minister Arjun Singh has claimed that India would take over Bangladesh by December 16 and vowed revenge for the killings of Hindus in the neighbouring country. His remarks come amid tensions over former Bangladesh Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina's proposed return from India, with Dhaka warning that she would face arrest and be brought back in handcuffs.

The notice requires him to respond within seven days to clarify discrepancies in his documents. If he fails to provide a satisfactory explanation, his passport may be impounded under the Passports Act. A pending re-verification will determine his eligibility for international travel once cleared.

title: Congress seeks 130 seats in UP, SP offers '26 winnable' ones
description: Samajwadi Party and Congress held lengthy negotiations over seat-sharing for the upcoming 2027 Uttar Pradesh assembly elections. SP chief Akhilesh Yadav suggested offering Congress 26 constituencies and emphasizing winnability. Both parties reported progress but no final agreement was reached during the three-and-a-half-hour meeting in New Delhi. Congress officials also expressed confidence in reaching a consensus soon regarding the alliance strategy.

title: Israel govt formation: Eisenkot, Lieberman join hands in bid to oust Netanyahu
description: Gadi Eisenkot's Yashar party has formed a coalition pact with Avigdor Lieberman's right-wing Israel Our Home party. This alliance is pivotal as efforts to create a government without Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu intensify. The Knesset was sworn in without a new government after the recent election reduced Netanyahu's majority. Eisenkot aims to establish a government by December 6, with an extension option available.

title: Delhi cafe horror: Woman gangraped by colleagues after late-night party, 3 held
description: Three people have been arrested after a 22-year-old woman alleged gang rape at a cafe. The incident occurred during a party organized by colleagues at the establishment late on Monday night. The victim claimed that two men assaulted her while others present enabled the crime. Authorities have registered a case and are seeking to apprehend three additional absconding suspects. Ongoing investigations aim to uncover further details surrounding the incident.

Additionally, Ilyas claimed that some JeM members are from the same communities protesting against the government. Indian officials are keeping a close watch, bracing for potential new tariff proposals. This probe builds upon prior tariffs associated with allegations of forced labor. India defends its position, asserting that its excess capacity is driven by projected demand rather than state subsidies.

title: Arunachal govt starts village-level talks on Siang dam, protest groups hold ground
description: In Arunachal Pradesh, local consultations are underway concerning the Siang Upper Multipurpose Project. Senior officials held discussions in Boleng with local representatives to tackle community issues. Opposition to the project remains robust, leading to planned protests in Pasighat organized by the Adi Bane Kebang United Youth Wing-Apex, who insist on halting the project. Effective communication among residents and officials is highly encouraged regarding this initiative.

He emphasized adherence to the company's code of conduct, asserting that it applies to all employees, including leadership. Huang announced plans for regular performance reviews, aiming for transparency and feedback.

title: Already gasping for breath, Delhi battles 14 garbage fires daily
description: Delhi battles alarming air pollution levels, exacerbated by recurrent garbage fires that emit harmful toxins. The Delhi Fire Service reports roughly 14 fire-related calls each day concerning these blazes. The destruction of mixed waste, including plastics, poses serious threats to both the environment and public health. Fire officials stress the urgency of fostering community awareness and promoting responsible waste disposal to enhance air quality through improved waste management practices.

This donation will support small-scale fishing communities and their efforts in marine ecosystem conservation. The funding aims to enhance local stewardship of carbon-rich seas and improve food security in coastal areas. Blue Ventures will allocate funds through the Frontline Community Fund to empower local partners effectively.

Additionally, police arrived but did not intervene during the incident. A formal complaint has been filed with the Ramnagar police station regarding the assault.

She is also passionate about sports, encouraged by her educators despite initial difficulties.
